bio: The hadith master of Baghdad in the fifth century and author of the manuals that fixed the discipline's method (al-Kifaya, al-Jami' li-Akhlaq al-Rawi). He opened his short book on travelling in search of hadith with this report, as scholars often opened a chapter on virtues with a weak hadith on its theme; a report's presence in a master's book is not a grade.
